requirement: A user shall be able to submit a URL string for analysis.
The system shall reject empty submissions and prompt the user to enter a valid URL.
The system shall display a specific rate-limit error message when the VirusTotal API returns an HTTP 429 status code.
The system shall abort the VirusTotal API call and display a failure message if a response is not received within 10 seconds.
The system shall return a "cannot be analyzed" message when the submitted URL resolves to a local intranet address.
The system shall classify a URL as "ambiguous" if the VirusTotal threshold does not conclusively meet the defined safe or unsafe criteria.
The system shall display a visual loading indicator while the VirusTotal API request is in flight.
A user shall be able to submit a new URL directly from the results dashboard without navigating back to the initial submission page.
The system shall display the word "Safe" alongside a green visual element when the API risk score falls below the danger threshold.
The system shall display the word "Unsafe" alongside a red visual element when the API risk score meets the danger threshold.
The system shall reject a submitted URL exceeding 2,048 characters.
The system shall strip leading and trailing whitespace characters from the URL string prior to validation.
The system shall follow HTTP redirects to resolve shortened URLs to their final destination before querying VirusTotal.
A user shall be able to copy the final verdict text to their operating system clipboard.
The backend server shall exclude the external API key from all network traffic sent to the client browser.
The backend server shall write the scanned domain name and the resulting risk score to a local text file.
The system shall display the exact time and date of the completed scan alongside the final verdict.
The system shall forcibly prepend http:// to submissions that lack a protocol prefix but otherwise contain a valid domain.
The URL scan result page gives an end-to-end response time p95 under 10.0 s with a valid domain submitted over a basic Wi-Fi connection.
measurement_method: 20 manual URL submissions timed via browser tools network tab; record p95 in the measurements log.

requirement: The running URL scanner app gets a health check pass rate of at least 29 out of 30 consecutive days during the final four weeks on the free hosting tier.
measurement_method: A scheduled automated ping that logs pass/fail to a text file.

requirement: A first-time Corporate Employee user finishes the task in under 30 seconds.
measurement_method: Two sessions with a stopwatch; time and find any UI stumbles recorded in notes.

requirement: Exactly 0 shown credentials, API keys, or tokens show up in the repo at any time, or during any user request.
measurement_method: A local grep search for secrets across the full  history; manual inspection of the browser network tab.

requirement: The system stores 0 bytes of user-specific scanned URL history to the server disk or database after a user successfully scans a URL and closes the browser.
measurement_method: Manual review of the backend routing to make sure no database write operations are around for user sessions.

requirement: 100% of the time, the UI gives a clear disclaimer right next to the submit button stating: "Warning: URLs scanned here are shared publicly. Do not submit internal company links."
measurement_method: Manual visual inspection of the deployed URL input form on page load.

requirement: 100% of interactive controls are reachable by keyboard alone in a logical order with a focus indicator that can be seen, using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Space, and Enter during the core URL submission and result-copying flow.
measurement_method: Unplug the mouse; run the scan-and-copy flow; write down every situation the focus ring goes away or a control is skipped.

requirement: Screen reader result announcement happens 100% of the time when the final scan result (Safe, Unsafe, Ambiguous, Error) appears on the screen after the API completes and UI moves from loading.
measurement_method: Run a test URL with a screen reader active.

requirement: 100% of form input have an associated descriptive text label on the primary URL submission form.
measurement_method: Manual DOM inspection in browser developer tools.

requirement: All body text and important UI text have a ratio of >= 4.5:1 against the background on all UI states and result displays.
measurement_method: Run a WCAG contrast checker tool on the hex codes that I used for the green/red text against the background color of the app.

requirement: 0 occurrences of information, severity, or state changes are shown by color alone when displaying the final scan answer.
measurement_method: Set device running the test's display to grayscale and go through the main URL flow; making sure that the text specifically shows the result without just using the green or red hues.
